evidence: The intensity ratio of the diffraction peaks corresponds well to that of a bulk sample. The polycrystalline nature of the copper films was verified in SEM and AFM studies which also showed that the size of the individual grains was in the range 0.1 to 0.3 pm and depended on the film thickness. The surface roughness was only dependent on film thickness and not on the deposition temperature in this temperature window and the films were also homogenous over the whole substrate area.
